verdict.name: Battery (AA, AAA, button cell)
steps: Tape over the ends so they cannot short-circuit
Keep batteries in a separate box
Take them to an e-waste or battery collection point

verdict.drop_off_text: Give it to an authorised e-waste collection centre, a brand take-back programme or your city's e-waste drive.
verdict.impact: Recycling batteries recovers metals like zinc, manganese, nickel and lithium.
